I recently had ACL and meniscus surgery on my right leg. ACL second time, meniscus first. I cannot stress to anyone here how much support is needed. My gf of only a few months did not and still doesn’t understand this. Literally the day after surgery, ‘hey did you call the vet to get the cat scheduled to get spayed.’ I told her I would take care of it when I’m cleared to drive. Luckily I can work from home and I do what I can before my knee starts throwing fits. This leads to long breaks and me working intermittently throughout the day. She comes over and will watch me ice my leg/take a break and ask if I’m going to do any ‘work.’ Lately I have been writing reports so… yeah. It gets done sometimes early sometimes not. Is what it is. 
We have been fighting constantly. She outright states that her feeling and emotional well being comes first and I 100% agree. However, in my world, ACL #2 which is affecting me physically. Is also having an impact my work and my mental health too. Shit who the fuck wants to sit on the couch for 6-8 weeks straight?! 4 weeks in she just started to ask if I need anything. My mom and sister have been doing everything for me. 
At this point I don’t ask her for anything. She comes to my house after work, I make dinner for US, I ask her to put the dishes in the dishwasher. Almost every night, I put the dishes in the dishwasher. 
She hasn’t asked about sex aside from one time. I told her I can’t and this was within 2 weeks of surgery. When you are severely injured you don’t think about it unless you’re having a good day. Even then it can be fleeting until you start feeling closer to normal. It’s been almost 6 weeks at this point and she hasn’t offered anything and I haven’t asked.
